name: Cadbury Gems
ingredients_raw: Sugar, Hydrogenated Oils, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids (8%), Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Emulsifiers (414, 442, 476), Colours (171, 102, 133, 124, 127, 122, 132, 110), Glazing Agent (903), Liquid Glucose, Cocoa Butter, Flavours (Natural, Nature Identical and Artificial (Caramel and Vanilla) Flavouring Substances).
